comparison.objective: Classify machined blocks with a go/no-go gap gauge and sort them into trays.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated gauge alignment, test insertion, binary classification, and object placement.
comparison.success_condition: All seven blocks in their correct trays for full credit, with penalties for false accepts/rejects; later versions also require evidence of gauge testing.
comparison.reason: Both use size-related openings, but this task individually gauges and relocates discrete workpieces. The candidate physically separates a mixed bulk charge through a screen while retaining every larger part and managing bridges and spill.
